Reference Class representing a region as Region_object

Source: R/region_base.R
Region_object-class.Rd

Object representing demographic and model-specific information for a single region.

Each region object contains information fields as well as calculated results of countries projections aggregated to respective regions allowing user to easily perform calculations and visualize the results on projection results for regions.

Details

Region_object stores results of projection aggregated to regions.

Fields

name

Character; name of the region e.g. "North America"

region

Character; region code identifying which countries belong to this region e.g. "NOAM"

structure_data

List; aggregated population structure matrices indexed by year label, summed across all countries in the region

previous_mortality

data.table; aggregated mortality output for the region. Columns: Country, Country_code, Period, Sex (integer 1/2), Age_group, Structure, Region, then one column per religion

previous_fertility

data.table; aggregated fertility (births) output for the region. Columns: Country, Country_code, Period, Mother_age_group, Structure, Region, Total, then one column per religion

previous_asfr

data.table; aggregated age-specific fertility rate output for the region. Columns: Country, Country_code, Period, Mother_age_group, Structure, Region, Total, then one column per religion; rows with Mother_age_group == "TFR" contain period totals

previous_fertility_exposure

data.table; aggregated women-population exposure for the region. Columns: Country, Country_code, Period, Mother_age_group, Structure, Region, Total, then one column per religion

previous_switching

data.table; aggregated switching output for the region. Columns: Country, Country_code, Period, Origin_religion, Structure, Region (light mode) or additionally Sex, Age_group (full mode), then one column per destination religion

previous_immigration

data.table; aggregated immigration output for the region. Columns: Destination, Country_code, Period, Structure, Origin, Region (light mode) or additionally Sex, Age_group (full mode), then one column per religion

previous_emigration

data.table; aggregated emigration output for the region. Columns: Origin, Country_code, Period, Structure, Destination, Region (light mode) or additionally Sex, Age_group (full mode), then one column per religion

Examples

# Running a full projection is time-consuming.
# Wrapped in dontrun to avoid executing during documentation build.
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
obj <- test_object_generator(object_name = "example")
project(projection_object = obj, progress_bar = FALSE, save_totals = TRUE)
# Access a region object by name
reg <- obj$region_object_list[["NOAM"]]
reg$name # "NOAM"
length(reg$structure_data) # one entry per projection period
} # }
